text:
rachel: opened a compact docs PR to add a 3-row demo CSV, tiny JS/Go meter header examples, and a short migration note for old headers. PR: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/2001

diego: can we keep CSV rows timezone-normalized (ISO8601 UTC) and include one example timestamp? reviewers love that.

rachel: yes. example row added: `2026-04-01T00:00:00Z,tenant_test,generation,256`

harper: please include a short fetch example but warn about exposing API keys in frontend code.

rachel: added fetch snippet and a small Go header example: `req.Header.Set("X-Redwood-Meter","tenant=tenant_test;billing_unit=tokens;amount=256")`

zane: tiny nit: call the column `billing_unit` (not `unit`) to match billing docs. Also add PromQL for reviewers: `sum(increase(redwood_meter_tokens_total[1h])) by (tenant)`

rachel: done on both. also added a 1-line sqlite import command so reviewers can load the CSV quickly: `sqlite3 demo.db ".mode csv" ".import demo.csv usage"`

docs-bot: preview build for PR #2001 started (lint, linkcheck).

harper: LGTM after preview check. adding a short FAQ line about burst credits showing as a separate metric so users don't misinterpret panels.

docs-bot: PR #2001 merged by rachel. release note: "metering: demo CSV + SDK header snippets + import guide"
